speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. Since you are a newborn, I will rely on your caregivers for your history; do you know if this baby was born prematurely or via cesarean section?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. Given the lack of prenatal care and unknown immunization status, has the baby shown any signs of infection, such as fever, lethargy, or poor feeding?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome. The combination of a continuous heart murmur (suggesting PDA), bluish macules that do not blanch (suggesting blueberry muffin rash), cloudy lenses (cataracts), and hearing loss is pathognomonic for this condition.
